Summary answers:
- Redwood signatory: Naomi Feldman, VP, Commercial Ops (I will Countersign the Order Form for hosted contracts).
- Routing: we recommend a two-step sequential envelope for this account to preserve an auditable trail: 1) Stellarus Procurement signs (procurement lead) -> 2) Stellarus Exec (CEO/CPO) -> 3) Redwood (Naomi). We can make the procurement step required before exec.

- Clean copy delivery: yes — we will attach the consolidated signed PDF and push to a secured S3 link; we can also deliver via SFTP if you provide an endpoint.

Proposed immediate actions:
- I will prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the following: routing order, ID verification for exec signer, and an optional witness field for notarization (if externally requested).
- Karthik: please review the attached Execution Checklist (RDW_execution_checklist_v1.pdf) and confirm no additional attestations required.
- Marissa: I'll need the final billing contact and CO name for the Order Form metadata.
- Jonas: prepare the S3/SFTP link and retention instructions for delivery.

If Stellarus wants procurement-first (procurement -> exec) we can do that. If instead they prefer exec-first, we will flip the routing — both are supported. Let me know which you prefer and we’ll send the envelope.
